raw_meta_yaml:
# win: no PETSc => only python
schema_version: 1

context:
  build_number: 1
  version: 3.1.0
  sha256: d1ba65a167aab221c13f003507aba17f663c53af94fc1cd4a47408008329def1

recipe:
  name: damask-pkgs
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://damask-multiphysics.org/download/damask-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: ${{ sha256 }}
  patches:
    - HDF5-Fortran.patch
    - compiler-options.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  variant:
    use_keys:
      - mpi

outputs:
  - package:
      name: damask-grid
    build:
      skip: win or ppc64le
      script: build_grid.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
        - if: osx
          then: llvm-openmp
        - if: osx
          then: pkg-config
        - cmake
        - make
        - sed
        - if: "mpi == 'openmpi' and build_platform != target_platform"
          then: openmpi
      host:
        - ${{ mpi }}
        - liblapack
        - libblas
        - petsc
        - petsc * real_*
        - hdf5
        - hdf5 * mpi_${{ mpi }}_*
        - if: not osx
          then: libfyaml
        - zlib
        - fftw
        - fftw * mpi_${{ mpi }}_*
      run:
        - hypre
        - ${{ pin_compatible('petsc', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('hdf5', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - damask ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - files:
          source:
            - examples/grid/tensionX.yaml
            - examples/grid/20grains16x16x16.vti
            - examples/grid/material.yaml
        script:
          - export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
          - export EXAMPLE_DIR=$(pwd)/examples/grid
          - "if [[ $CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION != '1' ]]; then mpirun -np 2 DAMASK_grid; fi"
  - package:
      name: damask-mesh
    build:
      skip: win or ppc64le
      script: build_mesh.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
        - if: osx
          then: llvm-openmp
        - if: osx
          then: pkg-config
        - cmake
        - make
        - sed
        - if: "mpi == 'openmpi' and build_platform != target_platform"
          then: openmpi
      host:
        - ${{ mpi }}
        - liblapack
        - libblas
        - petsc
        - petsc * real_*
        - hdf5
        - hdf5 * mpi_${{ mpi }}_*
        - if: not osx
          then: libfyaml
        - zlib
      run:
        - hypre
        - ${{ pin_compatible('petsc', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('hdf5', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - damask ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - files:
          source:
            - examples/mesh/tensionY_mono.yaml
            - examples/mesh/monocrystal.msh
            - examples/mesh/material.yaml
        script:
          - export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
          - export EXAMPLE_DIR=$(pwd)/examples/mesh
          - "if [[ $CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION != '1' ]]; then mpirun -np 2 DAMASK_mesh; fi"
  - package:
      name: python-damask
    build:
      skip: ppc64le
      script:
        - python -c "from pathlib import Path; p = Path('python/damask/VERSION'); p.unlink(missing_ok=True); p.write_bytes(Path('VERSION').read_bytes())"
        - python -m pip install ./python --no-deps -vv
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: python
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: pip
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: xorg-libxfixes
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - if: linux
          then: libgl-devel
      run:
        - python
        - pandas
        - scipy
        - h5py >=3.3.0
        - vtk
        - matplotlib-base
        - pyyaml
      run_constraints:
        - damask ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - damask
  - package:
      name: damask
    build:
      skip: win or ppc64le
      script:
        - echo DAMASK metapackage
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ mpi }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('damask-mesh', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('damask-grid', exact=True) }}
        - python-damask ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - damask
      - script:
          - "if [[ $CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION != '1' ]]; then DAMASK_grid -h; DAMASK_mesh -h; fi"
